title: Choose returned fields
summary: FastAPI: Choose returned fields. Add pages to the model and returned data.
introduction: A response model describes the public data. GET /book leaves out the internal note.
learningObjectives: Add pages to the model and returned data

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Choose returned fields

blocks.text: The public model names only title. The internal_note field is omitted from the response.
Add pages to the model and returned data.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Only return data the client should receive, even when filtering is available.
